answer.justification: Activation measurements match the system-prompted profile: layer-1 relative L2 of 0.138 and a steep climb to 0.307 at layer 8 (onset layer 8) and a plateau of 0.488 at layer 16 and 0.516 at layer 32. The layer-2 spike of 31.2 is far above the range for quantized (0.8–2.8) and fine-tuned (0.7–6.1) models. Final cosine of 0.844, effective rank of 2.83 and direction consistency of 0.544 also sit near the system-prompted ranges, and the mid-layer size ratio of 0.971 is slightly below 1, unlike fine-tuned (>1). Some values run slightly outside the document's ranges, which fits single-draw variation. Quantized is ruled out by the steep growth and low rank; fine-tuned by the spike, the shrinking state and the low direction consistency.
